STRATEGIC FINANCE @ CLAY

 - Lead the development and maintenance of financial models to support strategic decision-making, ensuring alignment with the company’s growth objectives.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze and report on key financial metrics, providing insights into performance trends and areas for improvement.

 - Drive the financial planning process, including annual budgets and forecasts, while ensuring accuracy and transparency in financial reporting.

 - Enhance existing financial processes and systems to streamline operations and improve data accuracy, fostering a culture of accountability and performance.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years of experience in strategic finance, financial planning and analysis, or a related field.

 - Excellent communication skills, capable of simplifying complex financial concepts for non-financial stakeholders and building strong relationships across the organization.

 - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, demonstrating initiative and adaptability in tackling challenges and driving results.

STRATEGIC FINANCE - FP&A @ CLAY

DATA MARKETPLACE OPERATIONS @ CLAY

Clay's partner and data marketplace ecosystem powers our growth, but scaling effectively requires high-level strategic alignment, robust executive governance, and cohesive cross-functional leadership across our entire organization.

In this executive-facing role, you will lead the strategic planning, analytics, and operational machinery underlying Clay’s data marketplace and partner ecosystem. You'll drive long-term business planning, establish scalable margin and pricing methodologies, and lead cross-functional initiatives across Sales, Finance, Product, and Operations to position the Data Partnerships function for sustainable scale.

You will partner closely with executive leadership across Data Partnerships, Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, Product and Engineering. This role reports directly to the Head of Data Partnerships.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

This is a highly visible role that sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, planning, and execution. You will partner across GTME, Customer Success, Finance, Product, Marketing, Legal, and Revenue Operations to solve complex business challenges, influence executive decision-making, and ensure the Data Partnerships organization is positioned to scale efficiently.

Strategic Planning & Executive Leadership

 - Lead quarterly and annual planning, key target setting, and resource allocation for the Data Partnerships organization

 - Establish executive dashboards and strategic reporting to evaluate marketplace performance, consumption trends, and partner unit economics for executive decision-making

 - Architect and implement scalable systems of record and operational governance for partner lifecycle management, CRM, and contract workflows across the business

 - Work closely with the Head of Finance and Head of Data Partnerships to design and/or evolve Clay’s partner model

Cross-Functional Operations & Marketplace Economics

 - Oversee the operational framework for invoice-to-cash, revenue reconciliation, and cost-of-goods-sold categorization across our data provider and product/technology partner portfolio

 - Drive operational alignment between Product, Engineering, Finance, and GTM teams to ensure marketplace billing logic, commitment tracking, and P&L structure, systems and processes support rapid scaling

Commercial Strategy, Growth & Analytics

 - Partner with Finance and Executive Leadership to define commercial models, margin standards, and pricing strategies across white-label, BYOK, and marketplace constructs

 - Build margin and partner health reporting across every commercial model — data marketplace, white-label, and bring-your-own-license.

 - Design the economics for marketplace-wide distribution — private offers, featured collections, sponsored listings, and co-marketing placements — spanning existing partner tiers and the next iteration/evolution of our partner marketplace.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Deep analytical capabilities with experience building financial models, executive dashboards, and strategic business cases

 - Cross-functional range: you can work with Legal on contract structure, Accounting on categorization and margin, and Product/Eng on how billing logic actually gets built

 - Comfortable building scalable process in a fast-moving environment — you'll be writing the playbook as the team scales, not executing someone else's

 - Bonus: experience with contract lifecycle management tools (Ironclad, Juro or similar), revenue-share or bring-your-own-license commercial models, or marketplace/platform monetization design

PRODUCT OPERATIONS @ CLAY

As Clay continues to scale, privacy and compliance have become core to how we operate and build trust with our customers. We're looking for a GRC Program Manager to build and own the operational systems that keep us compliant across vendor management, data privacy, and security. You'll be creating scalable processes from scratch to support teams across the company as they onboard vendors and handle customer information. MARKETING ANALYST @ CLAY

We’re looking for a Marketing Analyst to be the connective tissue between data models, insight and strategy. In this role, you’ll own the reporting, metrics, and insights that drive clarity on how our marketing efforts are performing. You’ll work in a pod with marketing / sales leadership, analytics engineering, GTM Engineering and strategic finance. You’ll surface deep insights, work with our data teams to build dbt models, and obsesses over what makes Clay’s marketing efforts successful.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Own the health of the top-of-funnel "assembly line": monitor lead flow end-to-end, identify where leads are leaking, stalling, or being misrouted, and drive tactical fixes with GTM Engineering and marketing.

 - Diagnose gaps between intended and actual funnel behavior — campaigns not triggering expected follow-up, routing rules dropping leads, conversion stages behaving off-plan — and quantify the impact of each fix.

 - Build operational reporting and monitoring (alerts, anomaly detection, funnel diagnostics) that drives day-to-day and week-to-week action, surfacing performance insights for leadership.

 - Ensure that data models, metric definitions, and funnel stage logic accurately reflect how the business actually operates, partnering with Analytics Engineering to close gaps.

 - Serve as the connective layer between systems builders (GTM Engineering) and data model owners (Analytics Engineering), translating operational findings into pipeline and model improvements.

 - Feed ground-truth funnel data and channel diagnostics into the attribution and goaling work led by Strategic Finance and GTM leadership.

 - Provide actionable insights into campaign and channel performance to influence in-flight decisions, not just quarterly strategy reviews.

 - 5+ years of analytics experience, with 3+ years in marketing analytics at a high growth SAAS company

 - Proven ability to translate data into actions that drive business impact.

 - Highly proficient in SQL is non negotiable (ideally python too); experience working with large, complex data sets.

 - Deep understanding of the marketing funnel, from acquisition to retention.

 - Track record of working cross-functionally with marketing, sales, ops, and analytics engineering teams.

 - Curiosity and persistence in solving complex problems; adaptability when findings evolve.
